{{Top}}
'''Wroshyr wood''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] harvested from the [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was used as an expensive flooring. [[Bornaryn Trading]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Tradewyn]]'', had flooring made from wroshyr-wood.
